Those facts independently certify both endpoint-created MAWs. The bundled script passed levels k=3..11 and exhaustively enumerated k=3..8, but the unbounded result is established by the written induction, not the checks.

value.rationale: The number of minimal absent factors measures finite-word antidictionary complexity. The construction gives an all-level logarithmic lower bound for an intrinsically dyadic, highly repetitive sequence, resolving not only distinct forbidden-word families inherited from the infinite shift but also endpoint-only obstructions with exact symbolic forms. These boundary distinctions require nontrivial factor-location analysis and make the result reusable in finite-prefix indexing, rather than a finite computer-only count.
